thread:
Hannah Kim: Hi team — weird situation. I thought I had elected Redwood coverage during onboarding but turns out my COBRA/benefits election didn't save due to a HRIS bug. I just had my baby on 2024-09-02 and hospital billed already. Am I completely uninsured for the delivery or can we get retro coverage? 😬

Maya - People Ops: Oh no congrats on the baby and sorry about the bug. Short answer: we can request retroactive enrollment in many cases if the election error was internal. Need a few things: delivery discharge summary or hospital bill, evidence of the HRIS failure (screenshot of blank election page helps), and your onboarding confirmation email. Please upload to Benefits Portal > Claims Help > Urgent and tag us.

Hannah Kim: Uploaded discharge_summary_hannah_0902.pdf and billing_statement_ovid-0902.pdf and screenshot_onboarding_error.png. Also forwarded the onboarding confirmation email.

Benefits Bot: Docs received for Hannah Kim at 2024-09-05T09:14:00Z. Note: Retro enrollment requests require People Ops attestation + carrier approval. If approved, carrier may reprocess claims back to the service date. Deadline for internal review is usually 30 days from discovery.

COBRA Admin: Looping in. If the enrollment failed due to an internal platform error we can submit a "Retroactive Enrollment Request" to ZenithCare and mark it as "Employer Error". We will need: employee ID (send via DM), effective date desired (Hannah: looks like 2024-09-01?), and copies of hospital claims. Carrier turnaround varies but expedited review is possible for urgent maternity claims.

Hannah Kim: Effective date would need to be 2024-09-01 to cover delivery on 09-02. DM'd last 4 and employee ID per your note.

ZenithCare Rep: From carrier side: we can accept employer attestation and supporting docs. For maternity (high-cost) claims we triage faster. We'll request claim reprocessing if we approve retro enrollment. We may need a signed employer statement certifying system error. Typical expedited SLA 5-10 business days. If claims were already paid by provider and posted to patient, we can request provider reconsideration or issue reimbursement after adjudication.

Payroll Ops: FYI — if retro enrollment changes deductions, you'll see payroll adjustments. For paid claims that are refunded to employee, Finance will coordinate reimbursement. If premiums need backdating, we'll process an off-cycle deduction or coordinate with you for repayment options.

Hannah Kim: The hospital charged a deposit and then final billed net balance $6,200. I had to pay $1,500 at discharge. Do I need to ask the hospital to hold off collections while this gets reviewed?

Maya - People Ops: Yes please ask the hospital billing office to hold collections and indicate claim is under insurance review pending retro enrollment (provide them the Benefits Portal ticket number if they ask). Also upload receipts for payments you made (we need those for reimbursement if carrier approves). We'll add a priority flag to the carrier submission.

COBRA Admin: We've prepared the employer attestation and will submit to ZenithCare this afternoon as "Employer Election Processing Error - Retro Enrollment Request" with a request for expedited review because this is a delivery claim. We'll post the submission ID here once complete.

ZenithCare Rep: Submission received (carrier case ZC-RETRO-4421). We flagged as urgent due to inpatient delivery. Initial benefits validation complete; we need the discharge summary and the hospital's tax ID to validate the claim. Hannah, can you confirm the facility EIN?

Hannah Kim: Added facility EIN on the portal and uploaded the receipts. Also DM'd the hospital billing contact info.

Benefits Bot: Ticket updated: Case ZC-RETRO-4421  Supporting docs validated. Estimated initial adjudication 7 business days; urgent cases often sooner.

Hannah Kim: Appreciate it. If carrier approves retro, will they automatically reimburse the $1,500 I paid? Or do I need to file a reimbursement?

Maya - People Ops: If ZenithCare reprocesses and pays the provider directly, the hospital will refund you or reverse the patient balance. If the hospital already applied the payment, we may get a carrier remit to the hospital and then Finance will handle any refund to you if needed. If we end up getting a carrier reimbursement to the employee, we'll coordinate with Payroll/Finance to avoid tax issues.

Payroll Ops: Note: reimbursements over a certain period may be flagged for payroll tax reporting; Finance will provide guidance if needed. We'll handle any net-pay adjustments carefully.

COBRA Admin: Update: Carrier acknowledged employer attestation and started reprocessing claims. They're requesting a quick provider authorization to re-associate the claim. We'll contact the hospital billing office and request reconsideration under member X (Hannah) retrospective coverage.

Hannah Kim: Hospital billing said they will pause external collections for 14 days while carrier reviews. Thank you.

ZenithCare Rep: Quick note: if carrier can't reassign primary coverage because of timing, we can open a balance-bill appeal and request reconsideration. We'll keep you posted in this thread once adjudication complete.

Maya - People Ops: Thanks everyone. Hannah, we'll monitor and update here. If you get any collection notices, DM immediately and we'll escalate. Also, filing note: we will do a postmortem on the HRIS onboarding path so this doesn't repeat.
